profile.headline: Full-Stack Web Developer
profile.summary: Graduated from Ozarks Technical Community college and have been working for McCurdy Real Estate and Auction for 3 years. My primary work consists of developing solutions to online auction software using Laravel PHP and VueJS.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of 4-5 developers to build and maintain https://www.mccurdy.com/
Conceptualized, created and managed projects to deliver new features and tools.
Work with project stakeholders to deliver a vision into a usable product or tool.
Developed in technologies such as; Laravel, Vue.Js, JQuery, and Vanilla PHP, MySQL, Ubuntu 20.04, Apache Cordova.
Contribute to weekly standup meetings to display task progress, address working issues, and outline future tasks.
Work with co-workers on I.T. support issues and address hardware issues.
Develop and launch a new software version that uses real time web socket technology (Pusher) to allow for our users to bid on real estate and personal property items.
positions.insights: Responsive Web Design, Software Testing and +5 skills
